html:
Update13 June 2025·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
Patch 1.3.5g
📢 Patch 1.3.5g – Now Live A custom patch bringing themes, Ultra Mode, a new event arena and more to ArcheAge Classic. 🌌 New Features 🎨 UI Themes You can now switch between visual styles in the game’s interface: - (default) - - 🖥️ Ultra Mode Graphics - A new graphics setting has been added, delivering enhanced visual fid…

📢 Patch 1.3.5g – Now Live

A custom patch bringing themes, Ultra Mode, a new event arena and more to ArcheAge Classic.

🌌 New Features

🎨 UI Themes

You can now switch between visual styles in the game’s interface:

  • Classic Light (default)
  • ArcheWorld Theme
  • Classic Dark Theme (Premium)

🖥️ Ultra Mode Graphics

  • A new Ultra graphics setting has been added, delivering enhanced visual fidelity for high-end systems.

🔥 Limited-Time Arena Mode: ULTRA RAPID FIRE

The 5v5 Drill Camp has been reworked into a fast-paced, experimental mode.

  • Balanced classes with significant stat changes:
    • ⏱️ Reduced cooldowns and cast times
    • 🔋 Lower mana costs
    • 💖 Greatly increased health

Available for a limited time.

🪙 Powerstone Update

  • Powerstone cost reduced: now 60 Activity Tokens (was 100)
  • Two new Powerstone Pet Skins added:
    • Toy Hammer Molang
    • Popsicle Molang

👗 New Vocational Gear: Dawnsdrop Costume

  • A new vocational costume, the Dawnsdrop Costume, has been added
  • Supports the Commerce proficiency

💍 Dream Ring & Progression Boosts

  • Sirothe’s True Blood and Crystallized Shadow now drop at 2x the previous rate
  • Family quests now grant 2x Family EXP

🏅 Arena Reward Adjustments

  • Arena Rankings no longer award Arena Accessories (temporarily removed due to balance concerns)
  • Arenas with limited entries now grant an Arena Participant Reward Box upon completion, which includes Warrior's Medals

🎁 Daru Blessings Trial & UI Improvements

  • A free trial of the Daru Blessings is now available once per account via the Marketplace
  • The Daru Blessings mailbox and warehouse are now treated as Special Skills, not items
  • The Gearscore value of gems will now display on their tooltip

🧠 New "Special Skills" Tab in the Skills Menu

This new tab consolidates non-combat utility abilities:

  • Siege Skills (e.g., Move to Base)
  • Premium Skills (Mailbox, Warehouse)
  • Gear Skills (e.g., Anthalon’s Necromantic Flame)

⚙️ Crafting Adjustments

  • Divine Die Recipe:
    • Output increased to 10
    • Fortuna Die cost increased to 10
    • Sturdy Stone cost reduced to 1
  • Serendipity Stone crafting cost reduced:
    • From 200 → 150 Earthmana Leaves
  • Pet Accessory Regrade Scroll crafting cost reduced:
    • From 25 → 10 Earthmana Leaves

❄️ Sunstrength Stones & Arctic Earthstones Now Unbound

  • These are now tradable

ℹ️ To update existing stacks: split and recombine them

🛠️ Miscellaneous

  • 🔊 Portal sound effects have been restored
  • ⚒️ Anchoring Charm ×1.5 and ×2 crafts have been disabled to avoid confusion
  • 🧊 Augur Lunafrost can now be applied to offhand weapons
  • Focus Gems will now grant a bit less gearscore to better reflect their impact on a character's damage output
